trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: There is no step of its own: the platinum unlocks the moment the other fifty-four trophies sit on your profile, so treat it as a receipt for a finished checklist. Work the roadmap from stage one, keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 4, and finish every missable strand before you trigger the finale. Once the credits roll, sweep the map for collectibles and activity medals, then mop up the money trophies in free roam.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening job doubles as a tutorial, so it cannot be failed for good, but it can drag. Stay behind Lucia on the marina approach, use the cover prompt on the first guard instead of firing early, and grab both crates in the cabin before you climb out. When the boat swap comes, take the helm and follow the channel markers south. The trophy lands on the mission summary screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 covers the Port Gellhorn motel jobs and closes with the first Vice City score. Follow the yellow story markers in order, but detour for the two optional prep jobs, the tow-truck grab and the fence tail, because they open the getaway route used in the finale. Bank a manual save before the last marker. The chapter trophy fires when the closing cutscene ends.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 pushes the cartel thread through Little Havana and the Grassrivers. The missions are linear, but two of them hide optional objectives: photograph the ledger at the second meet, and leave the deal with the money rather than the product. Neither blocks the chapter, though the ledger photo pays off in a later heist. Follow the markers until the dockside ambush resolves; the trophy pops on the drive home.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is the longest stretch before the endgame: three set-piece robberies, a chase through Downtown and your first proper look at the Leonida Keys. Do the safehouse upgrades between missions so you are not caught short on armour, and finish the mechanic's optional driving job, which unlocks a faster getaway car for the chapter's last mission. The trophy appears after the rooftop cutscene.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 turns the crew against each other and sends you back to Vice Beach for the penthouse job. Save manually before the boardroom marker: the chapter ends with a choice that changes which escape route you get, though either route finishes the chapter. Take the helicopter exit if you want the cleaner shoot-out. The trophy registers once the news report cutscene plays out.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The finale chains three phases with no checkpoint between the second and the third, so bring full armour, a scoped rifle and a fast car parked near the rendezvous. In the first phase keep your partner alive by clearing the balcony shooters early; in the second, take the coastal road rather than the highway to shake the convoy. Hold the last stand from cover. The gold trophy lands after the credits.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is the early-morning diner job in Port Gellhorn. Arrive before 09:00 in-game to catch the contact at the counter, then leave by the back door rather than the front when the alarm trips, since the alley gives you a clear run to the parked van. Do not fire first: the mission fails if the cook is hit. Drive the van to the scrapyard and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is the mid-game bank job. Run the two prep missions first, the security schedule photo and the drill pickup. In the vault, use the thermal charge on the inner door rather than the hinges, take the marked bills as well as the cash, and follow the tunnel route instead of the lobby. The escape car waits in the storm drain. The trophy pops at the safehouse.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is the custody handover that goes wrong on the causeway. Keep your weapon holstered during the meet, let the conversation play out, and draw only when the first shot comes from the bridge. Take the shooters on the north side first so the car has a clear lane. Drive your partner to the safehouse without calling the police. The trophy lands on arrival.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is the concert-venue job on the Vice Beach strip. Buy a ticket at the box office during the day to scout the layout, then come back at night for the mission itself. Use the stage-left service stairs, cut the power at the breaker behind the bar, and leave through the loading bay. Avoid the dance floor entirely; the crowd slows you down. The trophy fires when you reach the van.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown puts you on the airport apron after the cargo manifest. Park outside the perimeter fence, climb the service ladder near the fuel depot, and cross the tarmac behind the baggage carts. Do not shoot the tower guards: the alarm adds a five-minute timer. Take the manifest from the hangar office and leave the way you came. The trophy registers once you clear the fence.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is the late-game assault on the mountain depot at Mount Kalaga. Buy cold-weather gear from the surplus counter before you travel or your health drains on the ridge. Approach from the western trail, silence the two sentries at the gate, and plant charges on the fuel tanks before the alarm sounds. Extract by the snowplough road. The trophy lands after the debrief.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Completion is a checklist of checklists: story, side strands, activities, collectibles, properties, vehicles and a few hidden events. Use the roadmap view to keep the order sane, and finish every activity at least once before you start sweeping pickups, because some collectibles only spawn after their related activity is done. The pause-menu completion tab names anything still missing. The gold trophy follows the final tick.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts count any jump, wheelie, drift chain or air trick the game scores, so pick a vehicle you can repeat quickly rather than hunting the big set-piece ramps. The airstrip outside Ambrosia and the beachfront promenade in Vice Beach make the two best loops: run them on a fast bike for wheelies and in a low sports car for drift scores. Chain five or six per pass. The counter sits in the stats menu.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The activity board lists nine types: races, stunt races, drone races, shooting range, fishing, bowling, arcade, golf and the triathlon. You only need to start and finish one of each, so knock them out in a single afternoon. The bowling alley and arcade sit next door to each other in Vice Beach, the golf course is in Coral Springs, and fishing starts at any jetty with a rod. The pause menu tracks the list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Three ranges host the challenges: Downtown Vice City, Port Gellhorn and the surplus shop near the airbase, each with timed and accuracy stages. Gold usually means finishing under par time without a miss, so learn each lane's target order before chasing the clock. The rotating-target stage on the Downtown range is the hardest; take the pistol rather than the rifle, since the reload is shorter. Golds are tracked per challenge.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drones launch from fourteen pads: six around Vice City, four in the Keys, two in the Grassrivers, one at Port Gellhorn and one on Mount Kalaga. Win each track once; you do not need a clean run, only first place. Upgrade the drone's battery at any hobby shop first, because the Keys tracks are long and the stock battery dies over water. The trophy fires on the fourteenth win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: This asks for twenty different race events, not twenty wins in the same event, so plan a tour of the map. Street races cluster in Vice City, off-road events run through the Grassrivers, and boat races start at the Keys marinas. Set the difficulty to standard and bring a fully upgraded car; the AI rubber-bands hard on the downtown circuit. Progress sits in the stats menu under Races Won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal shows up at the Key Largo pier once you finish the third Kenton strand and challenges you to a bass contest. He is only there for a short window, so accept the first time he waves you over. Fish the deep side of the pier with a crank bait, and release everything under three pounds so your five best fish are all keepers. Beat his total before the timer runs out.
trophies.missable_note: Cal's contest is only offered during a short window in Kenton's strand; once the strand closes the pier is empty.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Any cabinet counts, and the easiest is the beat-'em-up in the Vice Beach boardwalk arcade, which offers continues, so you cannot really lose. Feed the machine quarters, pick the fast character, and mash through the six stages; the last boss telegraphs his charge with a two-step shuffle. The cabinets in Little Havana are harder. The trophy unlocks the moment the credits screen appears.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand begins at the rehab clinic in Coral Springs and runs four missions. It closes once Chapter 4 ends, so do his jobs before the endgame marker appears. The last mission asks you to drive him to the airport without a wanted level: take the back roads past the golf course rather than the highway, and do not stop for the pursuing paparazzi. The trophy fires at the departures drop-off.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.missable_note: Andy's strand disappears when Chapter 4 ends: the airport drop-off is his final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's three missions start at the marina in the Keys and centre on salvage diving. The strand is only open while the cartel thread is, so finish it before Chapter 3 ends. Buy the diving suit from the marina shop first, because the last dive is deep enough to hurt without it. Follow the wreck's port side, cut the two cables, and surface with the case before your air runs out.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.missable_note: Kenton's salvage chain closes with the cartel thread at the end of Chapter 3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy runs the bike shop in Port Gellhorn and his strand opens after the first chapter. He closes the shop for good when Chapter 4 begins, so do the three deliveries early. Each delivery is timed; use the dirt trail behind the motel instead of the main road, and never stop to fight the rival club. The final drop ends at the racetrack, and the trophy lands there.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.missable_note: Billy shuts the shop for good when Chapter 4 begins.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight separate stranger strands have to be finished, and several expire as the story advances: the bounty hunter, the photographer and the radio DJ are the first to go. Open each strand as soon as its icon appears on the map, finish all of its missions, then move on. The pause menu's Strangers tab lists which strands are complete. The silver trophy fires on the eighth completion.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.missable_note: Three of the eight strands expire as the story advances; leave them too long and the silver is gone.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand is the gun-running chain that starts behind the hardware store in Ambrosia. It runs five missions and shuts down once the final heist unlocks, so clear it during Chapter 4. The tricky step is the convoy ambush: park across the road to block the lead truck, then take the driver out before the escorts fan out. Deliver the last crate to the airstrip to finish.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.missable_note: Randy's gun-running chain is removed after the final heist unlocks.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's missions open at the car wash in Little Havana and revolve around the drift scene. Finish all four before the endgame, because the strand disappears once the finale unlocks. The last mission is a three-lap drift battle at the docks: feather the handbrake into the corners and ignore the score, since only position matters. The trophy appears when you park back at the car wash.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.missable_note: Tyrone's drift strand vanishes when the endgame marker appears.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditation spots are marked by a small lotus icon and only register when you stand still on the pad for a moment. There are eighteen across Leonida: seven in Vice City, four in the Keys, three in the Grassrivers, two at Port Gellhorn, and one each at Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga. Sit through the whole breathing prompt, not just the first frame. The collectibles map filter shows the ones you have used.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting trip unlocks at the ranger station on Mount Kalaga after the second chapter. He wants a specific panther, and the animal only spawns during the mission window; miss it and the strand is gone for good. Track it north of the station at dawn, take the scoped rifle up to the ridge, and land a clean head shot so the pelt is not damaged. Return to Bret to finish.
trophies.missable_note: The panther only spawns during Bret's mission; abandoning it ends the strand permanently.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards come in themed sets of twelve, sold in packs at convenience stores and dropped by certain enemies. Three complete sets is enough, so buy out the card rack at every shop you pass and trade duplicates at the comic shop in Vice Beach. The sports and muscle-car sets are the cheapest to finish. The trophy registers when the third set completes in the collection menu.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK is the in-game social app, and each check-in means standing at a landmark and posting a photo. There are far more than a hundred spots, so pick a dense route: Ocean Beach alone has fourteen, and the boardwalk, pier and downtown rooftops add twenty more. The app's map layer shows which pins are unvisited. The trophy fires on the hundredth post, with no quality requirement.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the rotating free-roam objectives that appear as a small card in the corner: timed deliveries, bounty targets, vehicle thefts and photo jobs. Fifty is a long haul, so take every one you pass and never abandon a chain, because abandoning it resets the counter. The board at the taxi depot in Port Gellhorn refreshes three at a time and is the fastest way to farm them. Progress is in the stats menu.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: This only works while your partner is following you, which stops being the default once the story splits the crew. Build a four-star wanted level somewhere with long sightlines, the Downtown loop is ideal, then break line of sight together in an alley, switch to a parked car and drive into the storm drain tunnel. Stay under the radar until the stars fade. Both characters must be in the car.
trophies.missable_note: Needs your partner following you, which ends once the story splits the crew.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: The three shops have to be robbed in one run, with the wanted level never clearing. Do it early in the story, while your partner still rides with you. Pick three convenience stores on the same road; the strip in Little Havana has four within a kilometre. Rob each one, stay in the car between jobs, and shake the police only after the third register. The trophy pops as the third till opens.
trophies.missable_note: The partner ride-along ends after Chapter 3, and all three robberies must happen in one run.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: A vehicle counts as discovered once you have driven or flown it, so the fastest route is valet work: the hotel rank in Vice Beach lets you cycle through dozens of cars in an hour. Add the marina's boats, the airfield's planes and the police impound lot. The pause menu's vehicle list shows silhouettes for anything still missing. The trophy lands on the hundredth entry, with nothing to buy.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time and marks targets; the trick is stacking five kills inside one charge. Start it in a crowded gang hideout rather than in the street, since the illegal operation in the Grassrivers puts six guards in one room. Use a pistol for the accuracy bonus and chain head shots without letting the ability drop. Upgrading the Focus duration in the skill menu makes this much easier. The trophy fires on the fifth kill.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: You need a plane and an open runway. Steal a Dodo from the flight-school apron, taxi to the active runway and take off without clearance; the tower will scramble two cruisers, but they cannot follow you into the air. A cargo plane from the far hangar works too, though it needs a longer roll. Any unauthorised take-off counts. The trophy unlocks as the wheels leave the tarmac.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the army's tracked vehicles, and they appear at a five-star wanted level or during the Fort Thompson convoy event. The easier path is the convoy: steal the tank off the flatbed on the highway north of the airbase while it waits at the checkpoint, then drive it into the sea before the army responds. Survive the chase that follows and the trophy is yours.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Take the jewellery store on the Vice Beach promenade rather than the downtown branch: it has one guard, a rear service door and no camera in the alley. Go in after midnight, disable the alarm box by the staff entrance, and use a silenced pistol on the single camera. Fill the bag and leave through the back before the patrol returns. Any detection voids the attempt, so quicksave first.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five separate bank vaults, each a small free-roam robbery rather than a story heist. The branches in Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Coral Springs and the two in Vice City share a layout: drill the inner door, bag the cash, then leave through the sewer grate in the car park. Buy the thermal drill from the electronics shop to halve the time. Escape without dying and the trophy counts on the fifth getaway.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armoured trucks run scheduled routes along the highway and stop at three depots. The cleanest hit is the bridge approach north of Vice City, where the truck slows to a crawl: block it with a stolen van, take the rear escort first, then use the shaped charge on the door. Grab the cash and drive into the storm drain before the second escort arrives. Escape to complete it.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Exploration counts districts, not roads: fifty-two named areas across the state, from the Keys to Mount Kalaga. Drive a loop that touches every town and use the map's fog-of-war layer to spot the gaps; the north-west swamp and the eastern islands are the two everyone misses. Entering an area on foot, by boat or by plane all count. The trophy fires when the last district name appears.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations, from distilleries and chop shops to grow houses and a counterfeit print works, and you need to hit one of each. They only appear on the map after you photograph a gang stash during a random encounter, so watch for the blue dot. Bring a suppressed weapon: the operations hold four to six guards and a safe that needs drilling. The trophy lands after the ninth robbery.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Book a table at the rooftop bar on the south end of Ocean Beach, the one with the neon flamingo, and order the house cocktail from the menu rather than at the bar rail. You have to sit at a sea-facing table for the animation to trigger, and it only works after sunset. Bring your partner along if the story still allows it. The trophy pops on the first sip.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The vehicle showroom on the Downtown strip has a floor-to-ceiling window and a row of sports cars. Walk in during opening hours, take any car on the floor, and drive straight through the glass instead of reversing out the service lane. A fast car is better than a heavy one: the window breaks either way, but you need speed to clear the forecourt. Lose the police afterwards.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kolt & Associates keeps a two-lane alley in the basement of its Downtown office. You do not need a score, just a full game, so book a lane at the counter, pick the lightest ball and finish ten frames. The lane oil is fast, so aim for the second arrow and keep the throw straight. The trophy registers when the final frame is scored.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This is a story beat rather than a task: it triggers during the television interview in Chapter 3, provided you let your partner answer the ratings question instead of interrupting. The prompt only appears for a few seconds and the scene does not repeat, so save before the studio mission and reload if you talk over them. The trophy appears at the end of the broadcast.
trophies.missable_note: A one-off interview prompt in Chapter 3; the scene never repeats.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The game tracks every dialogue choice, from story decisions to whether you help a stranger at a bus stop, and the trophy fires on the five-hundredth recorded choice. There is no shortcut: pick an option in every conversation wheel you see, including the small-talk prompts with your partner in the car. Reloading a save does not reset the counter. Progress sits in the stats menu under Choices Made.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: This one wants a failure followed by a success. The easiest setup is the shooting range: deliberately miss every shot on your first attempt, then score clean on the retry without leaving the menu. Any activity with a retry option works, including fishing, drone racing and even a stunt jump. Do not quit to free roam between the two attempts, or the counter resets.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A stranger in the Grassrivers hands you a map to a light in the sky, and the encounter only appears during the chapter where the swamp is open. Follow the marker north at night, park at the end of the dirt track and walk the last hundred metres, because driving closer scares it off. Look up when the radio cuts out. The trophy lands after the cutscene, and the event never repeats.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.missable_note: The swamp encounter is chapter-gated and cannot be replayed after the finale.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Any vehicle works, but a motorcycle makes the swing easier to time. Ride alongside a pedestrian on a quiet road, hold the melee button as you pass and clip them with the swing rather than the bike itself; hits with the vehicle do not count. The beachfront promenade at night has plenty of slow-moving targets and no traffic. The trophy fires on the first clean hit.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from robberies and heists, and they are worthless until laundered. Your contacts take a cut and clean them in batches; the barber in Little Havana, the boat dealer in the Keys and the pawn shop in Port Gellhorn all run laundering fronts. Spread the work across all three so none of them gets heat, and keep robbing stores between batches. The trophy fires on the quarter-million total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A shop means anywhere with a till: clothes, weapons, vehicle mods, property deposits and even hot dogs count. The quickest route is a full upgrade pass on two cars at the customs shop, which clears most of the total in one visit. Property deposits count too, so buying a garage works on two trophies at once. Ammo is slow but reliable. The trophy fires on the hundred-thousandth dollar.

sources.name: GTA Wiki: trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: There are eight garages for sale, and the expensive ones sit in Vice Beach and Downtown; the cheap ones are in Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and the Keys. Buy them through the property app on your phone rather than visiting in person, and note that the two on Mount Kalaga only appear in the list after you finish the ranger strand. Total outlay is roughly $1.4 million. The trophy fires on the eighth purchase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is the rental app, and registering a vehicle means adding any scooter, bike or compact car to your account through the app's garage tab. Buy the cheapest scooter ten times, or register ten different vehicles you already own, since duplicates count as long as each registration is a separate purchase. The app's counter shows your progress. The trophy fires on the tenth confirmation.

roadmap.title: Arrival: the first night in Vice City
roadmap.detail: Gone Fishing, the boardwalk arcade, the Ocean Beach bar, the bowling alley and a melee drive-by are all reachable before the first story marker. Clear them in one pass so the early map is already paying out.

roadmap.title: Chapter 1: Port Gellhorn and the first score
roadmap.detail: Push the chapter, run the two optional prep jobs, and use the quiet stretches to bank the choice and retry trophies. Nothing here can be missed yet, so this is the stage to experiment.

roadmap.title: Chapters 2 and 3: cartel money and headlines
roadmap.detail: Hot Together and Retail Therapy both need your partner riding with you, so finish them early in the chapter, before the crew splits.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4 and the road to the finale
roadmap.detail: Save manually before the boardroom marker. Finish every side strand you have opened before the finale unlocks, because this is the last safe point.

roadmap.title: Side strands before the point of no return
roadmap.detail: Ten of the twelve missables sit here: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, the Strangers strand count, Cal's fishing contest, Bret's hunt, the interview and the swamp encounter.

roadmap.title: Heists, robberies and the money game
roadmap.detail: Free-roam robberies, the five bank vaults, the armoured truck, the gang operations and the property purchases. Bring a thermal drill, a suppressed weapon and a fast car.

roadmap.title: Collectibles, exploration and 100% cleanup
roadmap.detail: Meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK posts, vehicles, districts, challenges and 250 stunts. Finish activities before you sweep pickups, because some collectibles only spawn once their activity is done.

roadmap.title: The platinum
roadmap.detail: Vice Got a Price! registers automatically once the other fifty-four trophies are on your profile. There is no extra step and no way to rush it.

meta.source_note: Trophy names and descriptions follow the official PlayStation 5 list for Grand Theft Auto VI (55 trophies, captured 18 November 2026). Guides, roadmap, missable warnings and stage order are original write-ups for this tracker. The PSNProfiles, Exophase, PowerPyx, IGN and GTA Wiki pages are reference reading only: the app renders them as plain links and never fetches them.
